title: Now playing
description: Whatever your Mac is playing, in the menu bar, as Control Center's Now Playing sees it: Music, Spotify, a YouTube tab in Chrome, Safari or Zen, any app. Click it for the track, how far in, play or pause, previous and next; Favourite while Music plays. Never starts a player, and asks no permission (Favourite asks once to control Music).
examples: A YouTube video plays in Chrome: the menu bar shows ♫ and its title; a lone ♫ while paused, nothing when nothing has played
Click it or type now playing: where it plays, a progress bar, Pause, Previous and Next (Favourite while Music plays, Copy link for a Spotify track)
